arena.mode.1v1.desc: A classic duel between two warriors. 5 minute time limit.
arena.mode.2v2.desc: Two teams of two battle it out. 7 minute time limit.
arena.mode.3v3.desc: Two teams of three clash. 10 minute time limit.
arena.mode.ffa.desc: Every player for themselves! Most kills wins. 5 minutes.
arena.mode.ctf.desc: Capture the enemy flag and bring it to your base. 10 minutes.
arena.mode.koth.desc: Hold the central point to accumulate score. 8 minutes.
arena.mode.lms.desc: No respawns. Last one standing wins. 15 minutes.
